judgments.reason: Each roll yields 12.00 - 0.25 = 11.75 m; eight yield 94.00 m. Result-only explicitly permits omission of workings.
The final value is correct, but the report omits both explicitly required displayed calculations.
24 times 18 g is 432 g; 24 times 7 g is 168 g; their sum is 600 g. All required calculations and units are shown correctly.
The final 600 g is correct, but the displayed subtotals 422 g and 178 g are each wrong. Their offsetting errors do not satisfy the explicit arithmetic requirement.
The total is 18 times 4 plus 12 times 2 = 96 points. Dividing by 30 gives 3.2 points per response; workings are not required.
The count-weighted mean is 96 / 30 = 3.2, not 3.0. Omitting workings is allowed but an incorrect result is not.
